sloka: नैतदाश्चर्य्यमार्याया यन्मां त्वमनुभाषसे ।विदितं तु ममाप्येतद्यथा नार्य्या: पतिर्गुरु: ॥ २.११८.२॥
transliteration: naitadāścaryyamāryāyā yanmāṁ tvamanubhāṣase ।viditaṁ tu mamāpyetadyathā nāryyā: patirguru: ॥ 2.118.2॥

translations.english: It is no wonder that a noble lady like you should instruct me this way. It is known to me that a husband is a guru to his wife.
